Use case: stylized-concept. SunDoku unified UI redesign proposal, premium friendly sculpted 3D casual puzzle game. Warm ivory #FFF6DF, restrained honey gold #F4BD43 rim, navy #092D63 accents. Frontal orthographic, gentle upper-left lighting, fine continuous rounded bevel, restrained depth, refined satin finish rather than plastic glare, clean generously rounded corners, consistent material family. This is an explicitly requested NEW style proposal, not replacement of existing assets. No lettering, no numbers, no icons, no sparkle decorations. Single isolated blank reusable surface with transparent margin; no scene or composed screen. Nine-patch friendly smooth center and straight side sections.
Extract or generate only the requested individual reusable UI artwork, never a complete screen or a flattened modal. Keep modal, card, panel and button surfaces blank, with no text, lettering, captions, labels or variable values. All UI text will be rendered separately with Flutter Text widgets. Reuse existing yellow buttons, cards and panels; do not redraw them as part of this asset. Keep the artwork independent from layout so Flutter can center the content and place yellow action buttons in the bottom action area.
Genuine transparent RGBA PNG background. Every pixel outside the requested foreground artwork must have zero alpha, including gaps between elements. No opaque background, no painted checkerboard, no scenery, no replacement backdrop, no wide halo. Preserve the foreground artwork and its clean antialiased edges.
Requested individual asset: NEW unified modal panel surface for pause, settings, level summary and victory. One blank broad portrait rounded rectangle, aspect ratio 4:5. Thin honey-gold outer rim with a delicate ivory highlight, warm ivory flat central writing area, very subtle amber shading near bottom inner edge. Rounded corners radius about 7% of width. Outer bevel about 1% of width, clearly much thinner and calmer than current neon yellow borders. No inset sections or embedded buttons. Fill 85% of canvas.
